To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the susceptibilities of the quark number, strangeness number and electric charge are sensitive to the inclusion of the multi-quark interactions and the isospin susceptibility is not sensitive to it.
the susceptibilities with multi-quarks interaction are in better agreement with the lattice results as compared to the susceptibilities with conventional effective potential.
the higher order susceptiblities are sensitive to the quark interactions and the inclusion of higher order terms is necessary in order to get a quantitative agreement with the lattice results.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the thermodynamics of the strongly interacting QCD matter.
the study of multi-quark interactions within the PNJL model, in particular the effect of the eight-quark interaction on the susceptibilities.
the study of the phase structure of the QCD phase diagram in the presence of multi-quark interaction terms and their influence on susceptibilities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the higher order susceptibles in the multi-quark interaction PNJL model with the effective potential containing upto eight quark interaction are in good qualitative agreement with the lattice results.

the inclusion of multi-quark interaction terms in the effective potential of the Polyakov loop extended NJL model leads to a better agreement with the lattice data for the higher order susceptibilites.
the inclusion of higher order quark interaction terms in the effective quark potential is essential to describe the susceptibilities of conserved charges in the PNJL model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the higher order susceptibles are sensitive to the multi-quark interaction terms.
the inclusion of multi-quark interactions improves the description of the higher order susceptibilites.

the inclusion of higher order terms in the quark interaction is necessary to obtain a reasonable description of the higher order susceptibilites in the quark number sector and that the inclusion of multi-quark interaction terms is necessary to obtain the correct qualitative behavior in the isospin number and electric charge sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inclusion of the higher order terms in the quark effective potential improves the qualitative agreement with the lattice QCD calculations.
the higher order susceptibles are not sensitive to the number of quark interaction terms in the effective potential.
the inclusion of higher order quark interaction terms improves the agreement with the lattice results.
